news.welcome.title: Welcome to Montam
news.welcome.message: News, events, and notices will appear here.
news.eventUpdate.title: Event View Updated
news.eventUpdate.message: Events load more reliably and the view is easier to read.
news.summonUpdate.title: Summon View Updated
news.summonUpdate.message: Banners, pools, and summon actions are more compact, faster, and easier to scroll.
news.shopUpdate.title: Shop View Updated
news.shopUpdate.message: Shop cards, wallet display, and product actions are more compact and responsive.
news.layoutUpdate.title: Game Layout Updated
news.layoutUpdate.message: Start, root, panels, status bar, and multiple menus were simplified and improved.
news.remoteLoadingUpdate.title: Content Loads Faster
news.remoteLoadingUpdate.message: Images, data, and battle content load more reliably and update more cleanly.
news.battlePerformanceUpdate.title: Battles Run Smoother
news.battlePerformanceUpdate.message: Battle scene, health bars, textures, reward display, and music were optimized.
news.panelCleanupUpdate.title: Panels Cleaned Up
news.panelCleanupUpdate.message: Gift Box, Daily Login, Missions, News, and Battle Pass use less duplicated layout.
news.inventorySaveUpdate.title: Save and Inventory Improved
news.inventorySaveUpdate.message: Currencies, rewards, Battle Pass rewards, shop purchases, and trades are more reliable.
news.contentUpdate.title: Content Checked
news.contentUpdate.message: Game data, images, and entries were validated and cleaned up.
news.teamSummonTradeUpdate.title: Team, Summon, and Trade Faster
news.teamSummonTradeUpdate.message: Lists, selections, and actions respond faster.
news.appCleanupUpdate.title: Start and Settings Improved
news.appCleanupUpdate.message: App flow, social links, version display, and settings were made more reliable.
news.newBackgroundUpdate.title: New Backgrounds Added
news.newBackgroundUpdate.message: Four new backgrounds add more variety to the game.
news.appStoreReadyUpdate.title: Release Prep Completed
news.appStoreReadyUpdate.message: Shop, Pass, Summon, Team, Trade, Missions, News, Gifts, and Events were polished further.
news.languageUpdate.title: German and English Added
news.languageUpdate.message: The most important menus, messages, panels, and actions are available in German and English.
news.legalLinksUpdate.title: Privacy and Legal in Menu
news.legalLinksUpdate.message: The menu now includes Privacy, EULA, Terms, Support, and official links.
news.shopPassBalanceUpdate.title: Shop and Montam Pass Improved
news.shopPassBalanceUpdate.message: Prices, rewards, purchase messages, restore, and pass progress are clearer.
news.summonSafetyUpdate.title: Summon Confirmation Added
news.summonSafetyUpdate.message: Summons now ask before spending Tickets or Crystals.
